_note: Single source of truth for the cut. Lyric lines are referenced by id only; no lyric text lives in this project. 'at' is the scene's start (seconds); a scene ends where the next begins. 'enter' is how many seconds the scene starts early to transition over the previous one. 'device' must be unique across the film. Palette rule: Tokyo Night everywhere; other themes only where switching themes is the idea (or the deliberate grey 'rented' world of verse 1).

scenes.idea: Power on. Pure ground. On the first beat a single lattice cell appears and blinks on the beat like a cursor; through the hi-hat roll it types itself sideways into a one-cell horizon line that runs out to both frame edges.
scenes.device: cursor cell blinks, then types itself into a horizon line
scenes.sync: blink on every beat from 1.277; line growth rides the 5.53-7.96 hi-hat roll; line flashes crest at 7.94

scenes.idea: Dawn of the field. The hero's dithered noise field rises up and down out of the horizon line, its edge a dithered front, drifting exactly like the homepage. Where the wordmark will live there is only a void, the word's shape cut out of the field as negative space. Field brightness breathes with the intro vocal ad-libs (vocal envelope).
scenes.device: vertical dawn reveal of the hero field around a negative-space wordmark
scenes.sync: reveal front follows the bars; brightness follows the vocal stem envelope 7.97-14.83 and 17.08-18.03

scenes.idea: The spiral. The field's lit cells are pulled inward and condense into the 15x15 square-spiral mark at giant scale (each logo pixel a 4x4 block of lattice cells) landing exactly on the 21.0 hit with a one-frame crest flash; then the mark turns in hard 90 degree steps on the 26-28 hits.
scenes.device: field implosion into a giant mark, then 90 degree step turns
scenes.sync: implode 20.06->21.0, hit 21.0; turns on downbeats in 26-28; settle by 28.6

scenes.idea: The title card, as a rack focus. Opens on i-03's last frame (hard cut, invisible); focus pulls from the mark to the camera, the mark melting into square bokeh while the song title condenses out of a haze in front of it; the focus hunts on the accelerating roll and locks on the downbeat with a crest flash and a push; the credit racks in on the ad-lib.
scenes.device: rack focus into square bokeh, focus hunting on the roll
scenes.sync: slow rack 28.65-30.79; glimpse on the 30.79 kick; one hunt step per roll hit 31.3-32.88; lock on the 32.95 downbeat; credit on the 34.58 ad-lib

scenes.idea: Locked down. A sterile grey world in the White theme: a perfectly static, symmetric grid. The camera dollies backwards through four nested bezel frames; each frame's padlock (an 8x8 pixel lock bitmap) snaps shut on a stressed word, closing us further in.
scenes.sync: locks on words 1, 3, 5, 8

scenes.idea: [line]. A column of original fine-print clauses (§ 4.2 Customization is not supported, § 7.1 Some features require a subscription, ...) rolls up like a teleprompter with inertial scroll; the active clause is highlighted, the rest grey. A greyed Accept button sits at the bottom.
scenes.sync: each word advances one clause with an eased step

scenes.idea: Every click is rent. A pointer clicks on each word; every click ejects a small receipt card (original amounts like -$9.99/mo) that drops and stacks into a growing pile, while a total in the corner rolls upward.
scenes.device: click-spawned receipts stacking with a rolling total
scenes.sync: a click and a receipt on each of the 7 words

scenes.idea: Tear it out. The grey world rips along a jagged seam stepped on the lattice and leaning 10 degrees like the site's theme slit. The two halves peel and fall away, accelerating and turning, revealing Tokyo Night beneath: the drifting green field, the first color in the film.
scenes.sync: seam opens on word 3, halves gone by word 7, green floods on the last word

scenes.idea: Black glass, late at night. A glossy black slab (the laptop screen) in a dark void; green terminal code glows on and in it; the camera glides at a grazing angle across the glass while a single reflected lattice line sweeps across on the beat.
scenes.device: grazing-angle glide over reflective black glass
scenes.sync: reflection sweep on the downbeat; code lines light on words 2, 4, 6

scenes.idea: Making one [line]. A terminal window (square, 1px ring) runs an install: package names scroll by (hyprland, waybar, mako, walker, alacritty, neovim ...) while a progress bar built from lattice cells fills in the wordmark band inks.
scenes.device: install log with a lattice-cell progress bar
scenes.sync: bar fills in 7 steps, one per word; log lines on 8th notes

scenes.idea: [line]. A unified diff in JetBrains Mono: the old machine's settings as red minus lines (taskbar=bottom, start_menu=true, desktop_icons=true) against Omarchy's as green plus lines (layout=dwindle, theme=tokyo-night, Super+Return=terminal). On the final word the red lines collapse to nothing and the green ones open up.
scenes.device: git diff: red lines collapse, green lines expand
scenes.sync: plus lines enter on words 2-6, collapse on word 7

scenes.idea: Ownership. A reader pad waits on the dark; each word is one fprintd enroll press and the print's contact grows a step, its ridges a whorl winding out of the square-spiral mark at the core; on the last press enrollment completes with a crest wave along the ridges.
scenes.device: fingerprint enrollment whorl around the mark
scenes.sync: one enroll stage per word (8); enroll-completed on word 8

scenes.idea: Picking the defaults. A list of Omarchy's defaults (Hyprland, Alacritty, Neovim, Chromium, Btop, Walker) with square toggles that snap on in a cascade.
scenes.sync: toggles on each word and the 8th notes between

scenes.idea: Drawing the lines. A pen with a lattice-cell nib draws partition lines that split the frame like a tiling layout: vertical, then horizontal, then vertical, then horizontal.
scenes.device: BSP partition lines drawn by a cell nib
scenes.sync: one line per word

scenes.idea: Wanting a system. Labeled nodes (linux, systemd, hyprland, waybar, walker, mako, your apps) appear and wire together with orthogonal circuit traces into one diagram.
scenes.sync: nodes on words; traces route between them through the 77-78 hit

scenes.idea: [line]. Every lattice cell in frame streams upward as an accelerating vertical streak; the ground falls away below.
scenes.sync: accelerate across the 3 words into the chorus downbeat

scenes.idea: Kintsugi: a cracked bowl; green light flows into one crack per word until it is whole and glowing.
scenes.device: spark-fed kintsugi seams on a lattice bowl
scenes.sync: onsets fill their word-cracks from the spark; key word fills edge to edge on the 82.338 downbeat; snares pulse the seams; dissolves into the glow by 84.90

scenes.idea: Exploded view: a machine hovers in pieces; the parts slam together, a click per word, and it powers on.
scenes.device: exploded-view laptop, key rows lock into deck
scenes.sync: each word a key row locking on its onset; kicks jolt the parts; key word slams the halves shut and powers on; snares sweep, flash and push into the field

scenes.idea: The name, set in letterpress. O, MAR and CHY come down out of the camera, shadows sharpening on the field, and bite into the lattice; the paper dents around each block and the fresh ink cools in dither order into the band inks.
scenes.device: letterpress line, name struck syllable by syllable
scenes.sync: words 1-2 pressed as type on their onsets; the name pressed syllable by syllable across its hold, the biggest press on the 90.86 kick; small type lifts off from 92.07

scenes.idea: The first viewer: over the shoulder, one person turns the screen to a friend; the glow lights both faces.
scenes.device: the first viewer, lit by the words
scenes.sync: pull-back on the rolls into 95.179; the turn through the hi-hat roll; each word brightens both faces; key word brings the lean and flare; push into the screen from 97.27

scenes.idea: Sketch to real: a pencil wireframe of a desktop on paper becomes the finished glowing render, word by word.
scenes.device: drafting sheet inked, then resolved into lattice
scenes.sync: each word inks on its onset and its window renders outward; key word completes the render; glint on 99.451; lattice shockwave on 100.01; resolves into the grid by 100.96

scenes.idea: Chaos into order. Thirty-two shuffled bars jump with the song's spectrum and swap on the sixteenths; from word 1 a bottom-up merge sort runs a level per word, sorted runs underlined, the jumping calming until a crest check sweeps the finished staircase.
scenes.device: merge sort that spells the line in letters
scenes.sync: one merge level per word puts the letters in order; readable as the sort completes on the last word; check sweep on 103.724; folds into the crest line on 105.837

scenes.idea: Heartbeat: a flatline on a monitor; a thump on each word; on the last word the green heartbeat returns.
scenes.sync: a thump on each onset writes the word as the trace; the key word beat mends the trace; heartbeats on 108.55, 109.02, 109.62; light drains into the spot from 110.11

scenes.idea: The unveiling: a machine under a cloth on a stage; the cloth is pulled away on the key word and it glows.
scenes.device: stage-lift unveiling, words pressed through cloth
scenes.sync: words press up through the cloth on their onsets; the yank reveals the lattice letters; the roll fills them with light; screen on and push on the 114.381 downbeat

scenes.idea: [line] place. An Omarchy desktop with waybar; windows spawn and split dwindle-style with Hyprland's pop-in, borders in the active color, gaps true to Omarchy.
scenes.sync: a window per word

scenes.idea: [line]. Circular ripples spread from the center and recolor everything they pass into the next theme, while waybar's workspace dots bounce like an equalizer.
scenes.sync: a ripple on words 1, 3, 5, 7; dots on 8ths

scenes.idea: Break it and [line]. The windows tumble out of the grid; a boot-menu snapshot list appears (Omarchy snapshots with timestamps), the selection moves up, and time runs backwards as every window flies home.
scenes.sync: fall on words 1-5, snapshot pick on word 7, rewind to word 9

scenes.idea: [line], still you. Two identical boot screens side by side (the mark and a thin progress bar) boot in lockstep, then slide together and merge into one desktop.
scenes.sync: progress in lockstep through word 6, merge on word 9

scenes.idea: [line]. A low camera glides along a 3D keyboard; keys go down in rhythm on real Omarchy bindings (Super, Return, Space, B ...) and the binding's label lights above.
scenes.sync: a keypress per word

scenes.idea: [line] beside. Two panes: the user's request lands in one stroke on the left; on the right the agent's answer streams in token chunks, its cursor riding alongside.
scenes.sync: request on word 1, token bursts on words 2-5

scenes.idea: Not somebody else's design. Glossy, rounded, gradient template cards (deliberately foreign) slide in on a conveyor; a one-cell-wide scan bar in the theme brand sweeps across and refactors each card into Omarchy's square, mono, ring-bordered style as it passes.
scenes.sync: cards in on words 1-3, scan sweep from word 4 to 5

scenes.idea: The one you'd drive. A highway built from lattice cells rushes at the camera, lane marks as cells, the wordmark a distant sign on the horizon, a terminal-style HUD reading out speed and version.
scenes.sync: speed steps up on words 3, 6, 9

scenes.idea: Defaults, physically. A 3D slot barrel of labels spins and lands four times.
scenes.sync: lands on each word

scenes.idea: Lines in space. Thin laser lines trace the edges of a wireframe room around the camera.
scenes.sync: an edge set per word

scenes.idea: A system, layer by layer. Isometric slabs labeled linux, arch, hyprland, omarchy drop from above and stack with weight.
scenes.sync: a slab per word

scenes.idea: Flying. The camera whips upward through stacked parallax planes of dither cloud.
scenes.device: parallax whip-up through dither cloud planes
scenes.sync: whip across the 3 words into the chorus

scenes.idea: Fix everything, as a status board: a split-flap board of system checks (wifi, bluetooth, audio, suspend, fingerprint, printer) flips each row from broken to fixed.
scenes.sync: a row flips per beat, last on word 4

scenes.idea: [line], in 3D. An original low-poly laptop, square-edged, opens its lid; its screen boots straight into an Omarchy desktop.
scenes.sync: lid travels words 1-4, screen on word 6

scenes.idea: Naming it with windows. Every lit cell of the wordmark is a tiny tiling window with a title bar; they spawn in a diagonal wave and settle into the word, then the camera pulls back.
scenes.device: wordmark built from mini tiling windows
scenes.sync: wave across words 1-3

scenes.idea: [line], round. A globe of land dots turns; meetup pins rise as light beams across the held note.
scenes.sync: beams through the held note

scenes.idea: [line], before and after. A dull, generic desktop on the left, Omarchy on the right; the divider handle sweeps across and converts everything.
scenes.sync: sweep from word 1 to word 3

scenes.idea: [line]. Thousands of lattice cells flow through the frame on a curl-noise current like a river, banded in the field inks.
scenes.sync: current surges on words 2-4

scenes.idea: The repair, again. The wordmark is a 9x3 sliding puzzle with one tile missing; it scrambles itself in a flurry before the line, each word slides a burst of tiles home, and the missing tile drops in hot as the seams close.
scenes.sync: scramble under the transition; 6 slides per word on words 1-4; solved and sealed on the held note

scenes.idea: The ultimate machine as a place. The spiral mark extruded into walls; the camera flies the corridor from the entrance to the center, then rises to see the whole mark from above.
scenes.sync: rise on the held word 3

scenes.idea: The day that was never supposed to come. A giant odometer rolls through the years from 1991 and lands on 2026.
scenes.sync: lands on word 7

scenes.idea: [line]. Out of black, a thousand tiny screens light one by one, faster and faster, until together they draw the mark.
scenes.sync: ignition accelerates to word 7

scenes.idea: [line] git commit graph grows endlessly to the right, branches forking and merging, density driven by Omarchy's real weekly commit counts; the camera trucks along with it.
scenes.device: endless commit graph with a truck move
scenes.sync: merges land on words

scenes.idea: [line]. Conway's Game of Life seeded with the wordmark on the lattice; generations step on 8th notes and cells age through the field inks.
scenes.device: Game of Life on the lattice
scenes.sync: a generation per 8th note

scenes.idea: Not just one laptop any more. Zoom out from one desktop: it is a tile in a mosaic of desktops in every theme, which is a tile in a bigger mosaic.
scenes.sync: zoom continuous, a mosaic level per 2 beats

scenes.idea: Anybody's spark. One spark cell runs a fuse path across the lattice; cells ignite where it passes and the 214.3 surge blooms the whole field.
scenes.sync: bloom on the 214.26 surge

scenes.idea: A system that changes with you. The hero melts continuously through all 22 palettes (perceptual interpolation), theme names ticking by.
scenes.sync: a theme every ~0.2s, slowing to rest on word 7

scenes.idea: [line]. The installer's first screen: a TUI form's border draws itself around the first question (the Omarchy 4.0.4 installer), field by field.
scenes.sync: border on word 1, fields on words 3-6

scenes.idea: The inhale. The field gathers into concentric rings of cells that begin to turn, each ring faster than the last, winding up.
scenes.sync: ring speed doubles every bar

scenes.idea: Twenty-two stripes, one per theme, slide in like a curtain, accelerating and compressing until they collapse into a single bright line on 242.32.
scenes.sync: stripes per beat, collapse on 242.32, line holds to 243.25

scenes.idea: Fix everything, everywhere. A grid of 22 hero tiles, one per theme, flips in a 3D cascade from the center out.
scenes.sync: cascade fronts on words

scenes.idea: [line], drafted. A technical drawing of the laptop: outlines, dimension lines, callouts and hatching draw themselves like a blueprint on paper.
scenes.sync: a drawing layer per word

scenes.idea: Naming it in 3D. The wordmark as voxels that rain into place, while the camera swoops around it from a low angle.
scenes.device: voxel wordmark rain with an orbit swoop
scenes.sync: rain words 1-3, swoop through the hold

scenes.idea: Every language the site speaks. The homepage headline in all 32 omarchy.org locales tiles out from the English one at the centre, each slot filling in lattice cells in dither order and cooling to a surface with the line set on it.
scenes.device: headline wall in all 32 site locales
scenes.sync: 4 slots on word 1, 4 on word 2, the rest across the held word 3; the wall rings on word 4; centre lights brand on word 5

scenes.idea: [line]: a coverflow of Omarchy desktops in different themes; the center one snaps forward on each word.
scenes.sync: snap per word

scenes.idea: The machine flat out, as btop. A square-boxed system monitor: the cpu history scrolls in lattice cells, sixteen core meters are the song's sixteen spectrum bands, and the process list re-sorts live as each word spawns new processes and pushes the load up until every core pins.
scenes.sync: drive steps up on words 1-3; 3 processes spawn per word; all cores pin at 100% on word 4

scenes.idea: Momentum by the numbers: GitHub stars 44,890, pull requests 7,789, contributors 572, set in a pixel digit font on the lattice, cells raining in as each figure counts up.
scenes.sync: a figure per word

scenes.idea: Still building. omarchy-update reaches 100 percent, then a new item appears and the bar keeps going, past the window edge; the window itself grows to keep up.
scenes.sync: 100% on word 1, overflow on word 3

scenes.idea: The ultimate machine. Everything on the lattice implodes into the mark at the center, then the mark detonates outward into the full homepage hero, reborn.
scenes.device: implosion to the mark, hero rebirth
scenes.sync: implode to word 2, rebirth on word 3, ring through the hold

scenes.idea: Credits in the site's footer voice: song, artist, made with (HyperFrames, Three.js, anime.js, GSAP), theme, omarchy.org; rows settle in on the beat.
scenes.sync: a row per bar

scenes.idea: Back home. The wordmark fires each sung word out of itself in lattice type onto a line beneath it, the key word storming in from every edge; on the hard stop a vortex spirals field, wordmark and words into the frame centre, kicked by the snares, until one lit pixel is left.
scenes.device: clockwise drain into the last pixel
scenes.sync: headline on word 1, buttons on word 4

scenes.idea: The last pixel charges on the hi-hat roll, then the snare and kick blow it apart: the owner's dot-matrix portrait of DHH flies out tile by tile on spirals unwinding the vortex, face first, and holds as the final image.
scenes.device: unwinding spiral burst into the DHH portrait
scenes.sync: drain to 297.6, final blink off on 299.8
